verdict.rationale: The only thing near event-triggered automation is Unity Build Automation, whose continuous-integration features and version-control support imply builds that run automatically on repository changes. Editor scripting and public APIs could also let users hook their own logic, but the docs never describe event triggers or rules. missing for 10: an explicit user-defined rule/trigger system for events, documentation of which events can trigger actions (e.g., commits, asset imports, editor events), AI-native or agent-driven event automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
